name: Buckle-Cut Blitz
text: Your squad dashes past enemies, slicing their boot laces and breaking their belt buckles. Signal up to two squadmates within the aura of your commander's banner; these squadmates can Stride up to their Speed as a reaction. Each enemy they are adjacent to at any point during this movement must attempt a Reflex save save against your class DC or become Clumsy 1 for 1 round (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure).
